en.headline: CUHK chief seeks larger loan for Northern Metropolis campus
en.dek: Dennis Lo Yuk-ming said the government’s HK$10 billion construction loan for universities in the new town should be increased so the university can plan a larger campus.
body: The vice-chancellor of the Chinese University of Hong Kong, Professor Dennis Lo Yuk-ming, said the university hopes the government will increase a HK$10 billion loan set aside for institutions building campuses in the Northern Metropolis university town.

Speaking on an RTHK television programme broadcast today, Professor Lo said Hung Shui Kiu was well located and that the new town could help CUHK expand. He said the university’s rankings and reputation were strong but that its scale remained limited, and that a larger loan would make future planning easier. CUHK is also working to establish a 10th college to add hostel places.

He said about 150 new professors had joined the university in the past three years and that 56 per cent of teaching staff were recruited from outside Hong Kong. The university has been recruiting in the Middle East, Southeast Asia and Belt and Road regions. International student applications this year were 75 per cent higher than previously, he said.

Professor Lo, who has been vice-chancellor for more than a year, said rankings were not the only measure of success and that building a lasting reputation also mattered. He added that he hoped work begun during his term would still be visible after he left the post.

zh.headline: 盧煌明冀北都大學城百億建設貸款加碼
zh.dek: 中大校長在港台節目表示，洪水橋位置優越，有助擴大學校規模，希望政府預留予院校的100億元貸款可以提高。
body: 香港中文大學校長盧煌明表示，希望政府就北部都會區大學城發展，將預留予院校興建校舍的100億元貸款加碼，以便中大規劃未來發展。
盧煌明今日在港台電視節目《廣播道會客室》表示，洪水橋位置優越，北都可以協助中大擴展規模。他形容中大目前排名及聲譽都不錯，但規模仍然不夠大。中大正籌建第十間書院，以增加學生宿位，吸引更多優秀學生入讀。
他說過去三年有150名新教授加入中大，教師國際化比例達56%。中大亦積極在中東、東南亞及一帶一路地區招生，今年申請入讀的國際學生較以往增加75%。
上任一年多的盧煌明表示，排名並非唯一指標，建立良好聲譽同樣重要。被問及希望成為怎樣的校長時，他說若任內能為一些對中大以至更廣範圍有長遠影響的工作播下種子，日後回望會感到安慰。
